title: controls.json — resolved review controls snapshot
description: The bundle's resolved review controls: fetch snapshots every control file at the PR base commit, and post/record refuse to trust the snapshot when its base or any used-file hash drifted. policy 'base' is the default; 'head' is the explicit --allow-head-controls opt-out.

schema_version.description: Snapshot format version; only "1" is trusted.

policy.description: base is the default base-owned rule set; head is the recorded opt-out.

base_sha.description: The bundle's base commit, the value post/record verify against.

sha.description: The commit the controls were read at; "" for the worktree opt-out.

strict_input.description: When true, record promotes review.json warnings to errors and refuses while any remain. fetch resolves it from REVIEW_STRICT_INPUT=1 or a .review/strict_input file holding true; absent means off.

files.description: One entry per inventory path, in inventory order.

file.description: One control path's snapshot status: used entries carry the exact written bytes and SHA-256.

path.description: The inventory path, relative to the repository root (.review/...).

status.description: used means materialized and safe to read; missing means absent at the source.

bytes.description: The exact bytes written to the snapshot.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact written bytes; post/record re-hash and refuse controls-stale on drift.
